role: Casting Director for a new series

turns.speaker: partner
turns.text: So many people are pitching ideas. What is the one surprising element in your concept that you think will grab the audience immediately?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Have you ever eaten a whole pizza by yourself? Anyway, my series is a documentary about small-town libraries closing. I'm Sam, I've directed two short films.

transcript: Have you ever eaten a whole pizza by yourself? Anyway, my series is a documentary about small-town libraries closing. I'm Sam, I've directed two short films.

rubric.check: Their first sentence is a hook: a question, a short story, or a surprising fact (not 'Hi, my name is')
The hook connects to what they say next
Still makes clear who they are or what their idea is

why: Hook first, but it has nothing to do with the pitch.
